name: cosmic-atlas-tools
description: Build-time only. Regenerates data/cities.js. Nothing here ships with the site.
comment: Pinned exactly: data/cities.js has to regenerate byte-identically. Both are permissive (MIT, CC0). The admin1, country and region tables are vendored as TSV in this directory rather than pulled from a package, so a regeneration needs no network and the region on a record is a lookup rather than a guess.
